mechanism_narrative: The steady rise in GROCERY_PHARM from -17.7 to -9.9 over three weeks signals normalization of essential errands, which spills over into discretionary retail trips and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose from -17.7 to -9.9 between t-3w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than its last 28-day mean when GROCERY_PHARM continues to rise or stays above -12.

mechanism_narrative: Once TRANSIT crosses above -35 percent and remains there for two consecutive weeks, reduced travel friction draws shoppers back to retail corridors, raising RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT > -35 for two consecutive weekly observations
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -38.6 at t-3w to -29.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT remains above -35 for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than over the prior 28 days, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The joint pattern of GROCERY_PHARM rising above -15 while RESIDENTIAL falls below 12 signals erosion of stay-at-home behavior; households shift from home-centered to out-of-home errands and leisure, lifting RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined from 12.4 to 10.6 across the four weeks
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM stays above -15 and RESIDENTIAL stays below 12.0 for two more weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last 28-day mean, the interaction claim fails.

mechanism_narrative: In an easing-restrictions regime, WORKPLACES mobility recovering from -34.1 to -30.4 indicates office return, which increases weekday retail footfall and raises RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -34.1 at t-3w to -30.4 at t-0w despite a t-1w dip
failure_condition: In an easing-restrictions regime, if WORKPLACES rises by more than 2 points over two weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than its last 28-day mean, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal outdoor activity recovery is visible in PARKS improving from -65.0 to -59.1; as park visits become less suppressed, surrounding retail-and-recreation venues capture additional footfall, lifting RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -65.0 at t-3w to -59.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS rises above -60 and stays there for two weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last 28-day mean, the seasonal spillover hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent RESIDENTIAL mobility above 10 percent indicates that work-from-home habits remain strong, limiting daily commuter traffic and capping retail trips; therefore RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks relative to its recent four-week mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is 10.6 at t-0w, still above its pre-period baseline
regime_hint: steady state with elevated at-home work
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL remains above 10.0 for two weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than its last 28-day mean, the negative behavioral hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed tightening regime is signaled if both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES fall below -35; the combined travel and workplace suppression would reduce retail footfall and drive RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are currently -29.6 and -30.4, above the -35 trigger
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both fall below -35 but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than its last 28-day mean, the tightening-interaction hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous crossing of GROCERY_PHARM above -12 and TRANSIT above -32 signals broad mobility normalization; essential errand and transit recovery reinforce each other and lift RETAIL_REC over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM is -9.9 and TRANSIT is -29.6 at t-0w, both above their triggers
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM remains above -12 and TRANSIT remains above -32 for one week but RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is lower than its last 28-day mean, the joint-normalization hypothesis is rejected.
